explanation: I grepped Mathlib for lieBracket_smul_right and lieBracket_smul_left. The only other match for the right-hand version is VectorField.mlieBracket_smul_right, in Mathlib/Geometry/Manifold/VectorField/LieBracket.lean. It is the manifold version. Using it here would mean specialising to the model with corners 𝓘(𝕜,E) and converting the manifold notions (MDiffAt, mlieBracket, mvfderiv) back to the vector-space ones. That is more than a short derivation, and the manifold file is built on the Euclidean lemmas, so it isn't independent evidence. I found no other declaration that states this product rule on a normed space.
